name: mirage
text: Thanks. The engine was still on the old, refused key when I checked at 03:09 UTC. I've told it to restart cleanly between scans so it reads the new key you just sent. This takes a few minutes. If the new key was accepted, the engine log will say so and Novig prices should read at about 16 a second again. I'll check it once it's back and tell you either way.
